title: Invite Check
summary: Shows a meeting's start in every guest's own time zone and flags 3 AM slots, weekends, holidays, typo'd domains and duplicate guests before you send.
description: Pre-send invite check that shows the start in each guest's zone, offers the nearest start that suits everyone, and flags night, weekend or holiday slots, typo'd domains, no video link or location, duplicate guests (+tags, Gmail dots) and resent invites.
catches: Start time outside a guest's working hours, at night or on their weekend
Guest's holiday, from your holiday source
No video link and no location
Duplicate guests hidden by +tags or Gmail dots, and an invite already sent
limits: Default working hours (9–18) and weekends are assumptions; pass each guest's real ones
Holidays come only from the source you provide
Needs each guest's IANA zone; it can't guess where they are
a11y: Per-guest start times are a labelled list with text, not only icons
Issues and suggestions are in a polite live region
Every fix (reschedule, remove guest, add link) is a button
stops: Invite lands at 3 AM for guests
